$comment: Drop your programs here — this file IS the target list. Per program: name, report_to (the official security email), policy_url or policy_text_file, in-scope source_paths / contracts, and requested environments. Environments are gated against the program's own policy text (fork/devnet only if the policy permits; otherwise BLOCKED). No spend/rate cap is imposed. The runner notifies you at NEEDS-SUBMISSION and NEVER submits.
